CRT-601.summary: AF Effect Display in OE for FX_SPOT
CRT-601.description:
*Context:* 

Currently for available instrument types 'Est. AF Effect' is displayed on the order confirmation page. For FX_SPOT instrument type 'Est. AF Effect' should be displayed on the main OE form as no confirmation page is available. 

*Acceptance Criteria*

1. Given the User initiates an order entry for a selected FX_Spot instrument

When the User opens the OE form

Then the User sees the field 'Est. AF Effect' among the form fields.

2. Given the User is on the OE form for a selected FX_SPOT instrument 

When ask/bid prices of the instrument are updated

Then 'Est. AF Effect' field value is updated as well.

3. Given the User is on the OE form for a selected FX_SPOT instrument 

When the User makes changes in the field Side or Quantity 

Then 'Est. AF Effect' parameter value is updated as well.

*Requirements*
 # Est. AF Effect value should be received from BE. Please note that for OCO group order the value should be received and displayed for each order in the group, for other group orders - for the main order only.
 # The value should be updated in real time (with a delay defined by FE) upon any change of:
Side or Quantity or Order price (price updated due to bid/ask ticks).
 # On UI it should be shown as: 'Est. AF Effect'.

See:
 * for advanced order entry [DXINV-028|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/DXINV-028] see [DXINV-CB-293;|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/DXINV-CB-293]
 * for group order [DXINV-178|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/DXINV-178] see [DXINV-CB-294|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/DXINV-CB-294].

CRT-609.description:
h2. Requirements: 

Charts for FX_SPOT should be build only based on midpoint, other price types shouldn't be available: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1737] 

Adaptive: not a part of this epic, see CRT-632 
h2. Scenarios:
 * Open chart for FX_SPOT instrument -> chart should be build based on midpoint price. In web and client area in webbroker.
 * Try to change price type in settings in web: change shouldn't be available.
